title: Unknowingly playing with my kitten Barnacle this morning
text: @ctv_marke unknowingly playing with my kitten Barnacle this morning. 😻 https://t.co/eSnK5L5jhE
blurb: The weatherman on the morning news was just pointing at a flood map, but a kitten named Barnacle decided that moving hand was a toy. Here Barnacle's little silhouette stretches up to paw at the screen mid-forecast.
